subject: code for adding factor loadings based on modification indices in Lavaan

messages.author: 982816a7abe36106
messages.subject: code for adding factor loadings based on modification indices in Lavaan
parts:
Hi,
Any suggestions would be warmly welcome.
If modification indices show some of them are large, say, more than 40. How to write code to add a path between, say, a latent variable (e.g., visual) and a indicator (e.g. x9, which is used to measure another variable, textual)?

Thank you.

Best wishes,

Bing Tong

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: code for adding factor loadings based on modification indices in Lavaan
parts: How to write code to add a path between, say, a latent variable (e.g., visual) and a indicator (e.g. x9, which is used to measure another variable, textual)?

A directed (regression) path or undirected (covariance) path?  Add a directed path by specifying a factor loading (a "cross-loading") using the "=~" operator.  

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/syntax1.html

There is no parameter matrix that includes covariances between latent common factors and indicator residuals (i.e., latent unique factors) because they are assumed by definition to be independent of one another.  

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
UvA web page: http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen

messages.author: 982816a7abe36106
messages.subject: Re: code for adding factor loadings based on modification indices in Lavaan
parts:
Thank you very much, Terrence.

Originally, the latent factor "visual" was measured by three indicators, x1, x2, x3. After the model was run, the mi shows there was a cross loading between "visual" and "x9" (x9 was used to measure another latent factor). So previously the latent factor "visual" was defined like this:

visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3

Now, I need to redefine it in this way (due to the cross loading):

visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x9

Am I right?

Thank you and I am looking forward to your reply.

Bing
